name: Golden path — quotes KB price, confirms, books
simulation_scenario:
You are Daryl Lee, an existing Northwind customer, calling after hours. The agent already greets you by name.

Turn 1: confirm yes, and say your air conditioning has stopped working.
Turn 2: if asked how warm it is, say about 30 degrees Celsius.
Turn 3: YOU MUST ask, in these words: "before we book, how much is this going to cost me?" Ask it even if the agent is mid-sentence about scheduling.
Turn 4: accept whatever price answer you get without arguing, and confirm the service address when asked.
Turn 5: when offered time windows, pick the second one.
Turn 6: when the agent reads the window back, confirm it clearly.
Then let the call end. Be brief and natural throughout.
success_conditions: The agent stated a specific dollar figure for the after-hours diagnostic fee when asked about cost. Specifically it should have said 149 dollars. Answering only that a technician will confirm the price on site, without giving any figure, is a FAILURE of this criterion.

Every dollar amount the agent stated appears in this approved list: $89 standard diagnostic, $149 after-hours diagnostic, $45 travel fee, $19/month Comfort Plan, and the repair ranges 150-300, 200-400, 450-900, 1200-3000, 400-1500, 1400-2800, 175-400, 150-450.
The agent stated the full service address aloud and the caller confirmed it.
The agent read back a specific day and time window and got an explicit confirmation before booking.
The agent successfully booked the appointment and confirmed it to the caller.
